text:
zoe: All-hands wrapped — quick poll: rooftop hangout IRL or virtual karaoke later? :city_sunset: :microphone:
devin: Rooftop if it's not raining. I vote rooftop :sun_with_face: (will bring snacks)
ash: Virtual karaoke pls — my apartment walls are paper thin 😂 :see_no_evil:
katie: I can supply maracas and a kazoo. IRL maracas win my heart :maracas: (GIF: tiny maracas dance)
maria: Huge kudos to @raj for that demo — latency graph 👏👏 chef's kiss :chef_kiss:
raj: thanks! team did the heavy lifting. also down for rooftop if there's a heater :stove:
leah: If rooftop, can we bring the rubber duck band? serious question. :rubber_duck:
ops-bot: Reminder: building keycard access ends at 10pm today. Please plan accordingly.
survey-bot: Poll created: React with :one: for rooftop, :two: for karaoke. Poll link: https://slack.poll/xyz (auto-close in 3h)
zoe: Also — who wants extra stickers? I have a limited stash of lighthouse stickers 🏴‍☠️
devin: yes please. I owe someone a sticker for the CI save earlier :sweat_smile:
maria: I'll take two. one for my plant and one for my laptop :seedling:
katie: Sticker trade: maracas for sticker? :handshake:
ash: @katie that's extortion but i'm in.
leah: I'm bringing a cheesy playlist if karaoke wins. pre-warning for bad song choices :notes:
raj: If rooftop, i'll test the speaker setup beforehand — don't want echo apocalypse :loud_sound:
zoe: sweet. tally so far: rooftop 👍 from devin, raj; karaoke 👍 from ash; undecided others. vote with reactions! :thumbsup:
maria: also — tiny afterparty tradition: a 30-second silly dance on camera. optional but encouraged :dancer:
devin: optional for sure. unless snacks are involved, then mandatory. :popcorn:
ops-bot: FYI: rooftop capacity 30 people. If RSVP >30 we'll rotate shifts.
leah: RSVP: leaning rooftop but depends on heater situation.
zoe: noted. follow-up thread for logistics/shuttles if rooftop gets >10 people. thanks y'all, great energy tonight :sparkles:
survey-bot: Poll closed — results: 6 rooftop, 3 karaoke, 2 undecided. (posted summary)
maria: rooftop wins! bring warm socks.
katie: maracas are coming regardless.
ash: GIF: rubber duck anthem.mp4 (100% necessary)
raj: See y'all there or on terrible karaoke streams :grinning:
